home_title: GhulSuite: passwords, 2FA, files, mail and calendar, encrypted on your own server
home_description: GhulSuite is a free, self-hosted app for Android and Windows: passwords, 2FA codes, files, e-mail and calendar, end-to-end encrypted with a master password and a security key. Your server only ever sees ciphertext.
hero_pill: Free software for Android and Windows
hero_lead_2: . Encrypted on your device, stored on your own server. No account, no cloud provider, no tracking.
areas_sub: Each area is its own encrypted vault. Switch on what you need and unlock everything at once.
pass_text: Logins, notes, cards, Wi-Fi and custom fields. Autofill on Android, password generator, security check, history and attachments.
auth_text: TOTP, HOTP and Steam codes. Import from Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS and Proton Authenticator by QR code or file.
drive_text: Encrypted storage with folders, versions, trash and photo backup. Share links without copies: every file has its own key.
mail_text: Your mailboxes over IMAP and SMTP, with OpenPGP, conversations and send later. Archive older mail, encrypted, in GhulDrive.
cal_text: Events, series, reminders and holidays, ICS import and export, time zones converted correctly. With links to mails and entries.
flow_title: Your server only sees random data.
flow_sub: Encryption happens on your device, with a key made from your master password and your security key. What leaves the device is unreadable for anyone else, your host included.
flow_1_text: Where the plain text is made and lives.
flow_2_text: Master password and security key or key file.
archive_sub: GhulMail copies mail as plain .eml files into GhulDrive, by account and year. Encrypted on your server, on all devices.
archive_1: Single mails, whole folders or everything older: large amounts run in the background with progress.
archive_2: Everything stays at your provider as it is. Cleaning up there is your decision.
archive_3: Automatic if you like: mail older than 30, 90 or 365 days, once a day.
archive_4: Duplicates are recognised: what is already in the archive is skipped and reported.
sec_title: Built like a vault. Open like a book.
sec_sub: Proven cryptography, a core in Rust and an openly documented file format. Anyone can check what happens.
sec_1_text: Argon2id for the master password, FIDO2 hmac-secret for the security key. Without both, nobody gets to your data.
sec_2_text: XChaCha20-Poly1305 for every vault, new inner keys with every change of protection, recovery with an emergency sheet.
sec_3_text: One shared, memory-safe code base for Android and Windows, checked with test vectors from Wycheproof and the RFCs.
sec_4_text: Shake, quick tile or auto lock. Screenshots and apps drawing over GhulSuite are blocked.
sec_5_text: No telemetry, no ads, no account. Remote images in mails load only when you ask for them.
sec_6_text: Updates from inside the app. Only what carries the developer's signature and matches its checksum gets installed.
sec_honest: To be honest: GhulSuite is a solo project and has not been audited independently yet. What is tested, what was found and what is open is all in the test log and the security report (in German).
host_title: On your server in five minutes.
host_sub: No service of its own, no database. A server in GhulSuite is an SFTP or FTPS login; for share links the app adds a small PHP module.
host_1: Any Linux server or NAS with SSH. Key login, the server's fingerprint is checked.
host_2: Classic web hosting with encrypted FTP access. TLS only, never an unencrypted connection.
host_3: Optional, on the same server: one PHP file (PHP 8.1 or newer, no database) the app installs itself. It hands out share links without copies and enforces expiry and one-time links. Your data stays in the GhulSuite folder outside the website, only the module goes inside; when installing, the app checks that the GhulSuite folder cannot be fetched from the web.
gallery_sub: On the phone and on Windows, light and dark, with one clear layout in all five areas.
dl_sub: For Android 10 and newer and for Windows. Afterwards, updates come straight from the app.
dl_zip_sub: For a USB stick, no installation
dl_stable_text: Released and meant for everyday use.
dl_pre_text: Newer, but less tested. For everyone who wants to try new things first.
dl_none_stable: The first stable version is coming soon. Until then, you can try the pre-release.
dl_note: Every version comes with signed checksums (SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.sig). The app installs an update only if signature, size and checksum match. The Windows installer is not signed by Microsoft yet: SmartScreen asks on first start.
oss_sub: GhulSuite is free software under the AGPL-3.0. Read along, check, report bugs or join in.
footer_claim: Passwords, 2FA, files, mail and calendar. Encrypted on your device, stored on your server.
notice_text: No cookies, no tracking. This site only remembers in your browser that you have seen this notice and which language you chose.
wip_text: GhulSuite is still under development and not suitable for production use. Whole parts of the app and the file format may change at any time, without migrating older data.
